hero.status: MCA student at SRM, from Northeast India
hero.intro: Hey, I’m **Raj Roy**, a.k.a. **KiNG** online. I make web and mobile apps, poke at AI, and travel solo with a camera. Most of my ideas start somewhere on the road. Hop in, I’ll be your guide.

ticker: Safarnama won the Special Jury Award

about.lead: Most of my projects start with a problem I ran into ==on the road==.
paragraphs: I’m from **Northeast India** and grew up in **Arunachal Pradesh**, surrounded by hills, rivers and a lot of quiet. That’s where two habits started: wanting to see what’s past the next ridge, and wanting to know how things actually work.
I did my **BCA at Assam Don Bosco University** and moved to Chennai for my **MCA at SRM**. Somewhere in between I noticed my two favourite things weren’t separate at all.

I travel solo a lot. And on the road I keep running into small problems: scattered info, no easy way to meet other travellers, nothing nudging people to travel responsibly. Those problems turn into my projects. **Safarnama** started exactly like that.
about.signoff: Not an expert at everything. Just a student who likes building useful things.
